outline.title: Ted Comes Home
outline.logline: Lost teddy Ted rides the train looking for home while Sam rides after him and waits at the station until they meet and come home together.
outline.theme: helping someone you love find the way home

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: A little boy who wants to find his lost teddy and bring him home, so he rides the train and waits at the station.

characters.name: Ted
characters.description: Sam's teddy bear who wants to get back home and rides the train while looking for the way.

beats.title: Home together
beats.summary: The book opens and closes on the line 'Ted sat safe at home with Sam.' Sam holds Ted close at home before the trip.

beats.title: Lost on the train
beats.summary: Sam and Ted ride the train together. Ted falls from the bag and is left behind. Sam sees Ted is gone and rides the train to the station to wait for him while Ted gets back on a train to go home.

beats.title: First look
beats.summary: Ted rides the train looking for the way home and sees one new thing: a tall green tree. Sam rides toward the station.

beats.title: Second look
beats.summary: Ted rides the train looking for the way home and sees the tall green tree plus one new thing: a shiny blue river. Sam rides toward the station.

beats.title: Third look
beats.summary: Ted rides the train looking for the way home and sees the tall green tree, the shiny blue river, plus one new thing: a round yellow sun. Sam rides toward the station.

beats.title: The right station
beats.summary: Ted rides the train looking for the way home and sees all the things plus one new thing: the station at Sam's red door. Sam gets off his train and waits on the platform. Ted's train stops and Sam picks him up.

beats.title: Back where he belongs
beats.summary: Sam hugs Ted tight and takes him straight home. The book ends on the same line: 'Ted sat safe at home with Sam.'

pages.visual_action: Sam waits on platform while Ted boards another train
pages.emotional_shift: Sam decides to wait; Ted looks for the way

pages.visual_action: Ted sees the tall green tree
pages.page_turn_hook: what else is on the way

pages.visual_action: Ted sees the tall green tree and the shiny blue river
Ted sees the tall green tree, shiny blue river, and round yellow sun
Ted sees the station, train stops, Sam picks him up
Sam hugs Ted and they sit safe at home

pages.text:
Sam holds Ted close.
They sit together.
Home is quiet around them.

The train starts moving.
Ted slips from the bag.
Sam reaches in and stops.

Sam stands on the platform.
He waits by the track.
Ted climbs onto the next train.

Ted rides along.
A tall green tree passes by.
Ted watches it go.

The tall green tree stays in sight.
A shiny blue river appears.
Ted keeps watching.

The tall green tree.
The shiny blue river.
A round yellow sun joins them.

Ted sees the station.
The train stops.
Sam picks him up.

Sam hugs Ted tight.
They sit together again.
Home waits for them.
